purpose: Unique legal filing identifier
important_caveat: Defines the transaction-counting grain

purpose: Detailed source filing type
important_caveat: Set to CONFLICTING when parcel rows disagree

purpose: Analysis category for deed, mortgage, lifecycle, other, or unknown
important_caveat: Use sale_deed and new_mortgage for the main research question

purpose: Broad Sale, Loan, Other, or Conflicting label
important_caveat: Loan combines new mortgages with mortgage lifecycle filings; use activity_type when the distinction matters

purpose: Identifies a sale document whose detailed type is not exact DEED
aggregation_rule: Any deed-variant parcel when the activity category is consistent
important_caveat: Variant deeds remain in sale counts but can be isolated in sensitivity checks

purpose: Canonical filing date used by the project
aggregation_rule: Earliest recording/display date when source rows disagree
important_caveat: Drives the January 2000 through July 2026 analysis window

purpose: Earliest date the instrument was executed
important_caveat: Dates outside 1800-2025 are treated as missing; not the default revenue-recognition date

purpose: Earliest date the filing was received
important_caveat: Compare with record_date before using for revenue timing

purpose: Days from document execution to recording
important_caveat: Can be negative when source dates are inconsistent

purpose: Days from receipt to recording
important_caveat: Can be negative when source dates are inconsistent

purpose: Calendar year of record_date
important_caveat: Not a fiscal-year field

purpose: Calendar month number of record_date
important_caveat: Use yr_mo for time-series grouping

purpose: First day of the record month
important_caveat: Monthly analysis key

purpose: First day of the record quarter
important_caveat: Calendar quarter

purpose: Single ward used for additive ward totals
aggregation_rule: Most parcel rows; lowest ward breaks a tie
important_caveat: A practical allocation rule for multi-ward documents

purpose: Single five-digit ZIP used for additive ZIP totals
aggregation_rule: Most parcel rows; lowest ZIP breaks a tie
important_caveat: A practical allocation rule for multi-ZIP documents

purpose: Number of source parcel rows in the document
important_caveat: Values above one identify multi-parcel filings

purpose: Number of wards touched by the document
important_caveat: Zero means ward is unavailable

purpose: Number of ZIP codes touched by the document
important_caveat: Zero means ZIP is unavailable

purpose: Safe additive transaction counter
important_caveat: Sum this field for transaction volume

purpose: Document consideration used for analysis
aggregation_rule: Sum complete adjusted parcel allocations; otherwise use one consistent reported document value
important_caveat: Mortgage consideration is too incomplete for loan-value analysis

purpose: Share of parcel rows with adjusted consideration
aggregation_rule: Nonmissing adjusted rows divided by parcel rows
important_caveat: Values below 1 trigger the reported-value fallback when available

purpose: Rule used to create total_consideration
important_caveat: Distinguishes adjusted sums from reported fallbacks

purpose: Adjusted parcel sum minus reported document consideration
aggregation_rule: Calculated when both are fully available
important_caveat: Investigate material nonzero differences

purpose: Recorded Philadelphia transfer-tax amount
aggregation_rule: Sum complete adjusted parcel allocations; otherwise use one consistent reported document value
important_caveat: Recorded filing amount is not automatically cash revenue received

purpose: Share of parcel rows with adjusted local tax
aggregation_rule: Nonmissing adjusted rows divided by parcel rows
important_caveat: Values below 1 trigger the reported-value fallback when available

purpose: Rule used to create local_tax_amount
important_caveat: Distinguishes adjusted sums from reported fallbacks

purpose: Adjusted parcel tax sum minus reported local tax
aggregation_rule: Calculated when both are fully available
important_caveat: Investigate material nonzero differences

purpose: Recorded Commonwealth transfer-tax amount
aggregation_rule: Sum complete adjusted parcel allocations; otherwise use one consistent reported document value
important_caveat: Included as a reconciliation field, not City revenue

purpose: Share of parcel rows with adjusted state tax
aggregation_rule: Nonmissing adjusted rows divided by parcel rows
important_caveat: Values below 1 trigger the reported-value fallback when available

purpose: Rule used to create state_tax_amount
important_caveat: Distinguishes adjusted sums from reported fallbacks

purpose: Adjusted parcel tax sum minus reported state tax
aggregation_rule: Calculated when both are fully available
important_caveat: Investigate material nonzero differences

purpose: Sum of available assessed values across parcel rows
important_caveat: Do not treat missing parcels as zero-valued property

purpose: Median available parcel assessed value
important_caveat: Primarily descriptive for multi-parcel documents

purpose: Parcel rows with an assessed value
important_caveat: Compare with n_parcel_rows

purpose: Share of parcel rows with assessed values
important_caveat: Low coverage weakens document-level assessment comparisons

purpose: Deed with reported consideration at or below $100
important_caveat: Missing consideration is not classified as nominal

purpose: Deed with missing consideration
important_caveat: Keep separate from nominal transfers

purpose: Non-nominal sale above the 99.9th percentile of eligible document consideration
important_caveat: Retain the transaction but exclude it from typical-price summaries

purpose: Parcel rows disagree on activity category
important_caveat: Conflicted documents should be reviewed before category modeling

purpose: Parcel rows disagree on detailed document type
important_caveat: Detailed type is replaced by CONFLICTING

purpose: Parcel rows disagree on canonical record date
important_caveat: Earliest date is retained

purpose: Parcel rows disagree on document date
important_caveat: Earliest date is retained

purpose: Parcel rows disagree on receipt date
important_caveat: Earliest date is retained

purpose: Reported document consideration differs across parcel rows
important_caveat: Complete adjusted parcel allocations can still supply the document total

purpose: Reported local tax differs across parcel rows
important_caveat: Complete adjusted parcel allocations can still supply the document total

purpose: Reported state tax differs across parcel rows
important_caveat: Complete adjusted parcel allocations can still supply the document total
